## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](../DCO).
- [ ] The change follows the rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), and the checks for the touched parts pass.
- [ ] New mechanics, tables, values or tools are wired end to end, including the app's controls, the book and the Codex.
- [ ] No comments or docstrings were added.
- [ ] Any new third-party code, asset or model is listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), and in [REUSE.toml](../REUSE.toml) if it lives in the repository.
